# Luggage & Suitcases

Shop the finest luggage and suitcases from over a century of expert curation. At Case Luggage - established 1923 - every piece in this collection is chosen for its craftsmanship, performance, and enduring design. Whether you need a lightweight [cabin suitcase](https://www.caseluggage.com/collections/cabin-luggage) for hand-baggage-only travel or a spacious [check-in case](https://www.caseluggage.com/collections/check-in-luggage) for longer adventures, you'll find it here alongside the world's most trusted names. [Tumi's 19 Degree Aluminium](https://www.caseluggage.com/collections/tumi-19-degree-aluminium-suitcases) spinners sit alongside [Samsonite C-Lite](https://www.caseluggage.com/collections/samsonite-c-lite-suitcases) featherweights, [Bric's Italian-crafted spinners](https://www.caseluggage.com/collections/brics), and the unconditionally lifetime-guaranteed engineering of [Briggs & Riley](https://www.caseluggage.com/collections/briggs-riley). Hard-shell or soft, cabin or hold - this is where serious travellers start.

#### How Do I Clean & Maintain My Suitcase?

To clean your suitcase, wipe the exterior with a damp cloth using mild soap for stains. For hard-shell luggage, avoid abrasive cleaners. The interior can often be cleaned with a vacuum or cloth. Always check the care instructions provided by the manufacturer for specific maintenance recommendations.

### What Is Spinner Luggage?

Spinner luggage is a type of suitcase with four multi-directional wheels, often referred to as 'spinners'. These wheels rotate 360 degrees, offering superior manoeuvrability compared to traditional two-wheeled suitcases.

Spinner luggage allows you to effortlessly wheel your suitcase alongside you in any direction - forward, backwards, or sideways. This makes navigating through crowded airports, narrow aeroplane aisles, or uneven surfaces much easier and less taxing on your arms and shoulders.

### How Can I Protect My Luggage During Travel?

To protect your luggage, consider using a [luggage cover](https://www.caseluggage.com/accessories/suitcase-covers.html), investing in a suitcase with a hard shell, and choosing luggage with high-quality, durable materials. Locking your suitcase with a TSA-approved lock can also deter theft.

### What's The Difference Between Hard Suitcases & Soft Luggage?

The primary difference between hard and soft luggage lies in the material they're made from and their overall structure.

- **Hard Luggage:** Hardside luggage is constructed from rigid materials such as polycarbonate, ABS, or aluminium. These materials give the suitcase a solid structure, providing excellent protection for your belongings against impacts or rough handling during transit. Hard luggage is also typically more resistant to water and can be easily wiped clean.
- **Soft Luggage:** Soft side luggage is made from flexible fabrics such as nylon or polyester. One of the main advantages of soft luggage is its flexibility. Many softside bags can expand, providing you with extra packing space when needed. Soft luggage also often features external pockets, giving you easy access to travel essentials.

### How Do I Choose The Right Size Suitcase?

Choosing the right size suitcase depends on several factors, including the duration of your trip, your destination, and your packing habits. Remember, it's important to consider your airline's baggage allowances and restrictions when choosing your suitcase size. Here's a brief guide to help you make the right choice in choosing the perfect luggage for you:

1. **Carry-On Luggage:** If you're planning for a short trip, or a weekend getaway, or if you prefer to travel light and carry-on luggage. Our carry-on suitcases are designed to comply with airline size restrictions for cabin baggage, ensuring that you can keep your essentials nearby during your flight.
2. [Medium Suitcases](https://www.caseluggage.com/luggage/medium-suitcases.html) **or Check-In Suitcases:** For trips lasting up to a week, our medium-sized suitcases offer ample space for all your travel necessities without being too bulky. They're a popular choice among travellers for their versatility and convenience.
3. **Large and Extra-Large Check-In Suitcases:** If you're embarking on a long vacation, planning a family holiday, or need to pack extra items like sports equipment, our [large suitcase](https://www.caseluggage.com/luggage/large-suitcases.html) or [extra large suitcases](https://www.caseluggage.com/luggage/extra-large-suitcases.html) would be ideal. These offer generous packing space and often come with useful features such as divider panels and multiple compartments for organised packing.

### Are Luggage Trackers Worth It?

Luggage trackers use GPS technology to help you locate misplaced, lost, or stolen bags. They can be particularly useful if you frequently travel with valuable items or if you're prone to losing your luggage.

While a luggage tracker might not necessarily speed up the process of retrieving your bag from an airline, it can provide real-time data about your luggage's location. This could be especially helpful in situations where your bag has been wrongly routed or taken by mistake.
